value.rationale: The class of local Artinian Gorenstein algebras with Hilbert function (1,m,1) and nondegenerate multiplication pairing is canonical. The complete rank spectrum distinguishes quadratic isometry types over the same field and dimension, identifies a sharp rank-two failure of radical preservation and rigid preservation at all higher ranks, and supplies exact finite-field arithmetic formulas uniformly in m. This is a nontrivial natural operator classification and useful algebraic invariant, not a routine one-number computation.
